apiContracts: Author novel create and update reject remote, protocol-relative, malformed, unbundled and unsafe cover paths.
Administrator novel create and update enforce the same exact same-origin allowlist.
The default CSP blocks remote image sources; HTTPS is permitted only on chapter-reader routes.
dataEntities: Existing novels.cover_url field only; no new entity or migration.

migrationPlan.canonicalEntityReuse: Reuse existing novels.cover_url field and bundled public/covers assets.
migrationPlan.backwardCompatibility: Existing known bundled paths remain valid; legacy remote cover values fall back to the safe local placeholder when changed.
migrationPlan.rollbackOrForwardRepair: Revert the code and UI boundary; no schema or data migration is introduced.

uiLifecycle.clientBootBehavior: Client cover rendering uses an exact bundled allowlist and local placeholder.

privacySecurity.authentication: Existing author/admin authentication requirements remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.authorization: All author and admin write routes validate covers server-side.
privacySecurity.ownerScoping: Existing author ownership checks remain unchanged.
privacySecurity.csrf: Existing same-origin/session CSRF protection remains unchanged.
privacySecurity.rateAndSizeLimits: No new request size or rate-limit behavior.
privacySecurity.rightsAndPrivacy: Arbitrary remote cover URLs are rejected to prevent third-party tracking and untrusted image sources.

integration: Cloudflare Source Validation exact-head build and route checks
isolation: Server rejects external cover URLs on all four author/admin write paths.

stagingSteps: Verify all eight bundled cover paths and placeholder exist in the deployed asset bundle.
Verify external, protocol-relative, javascript, data, file, traversal, query and fragment URLs are rejected.
Verify HTTPS comic page media remains available only on reader routes.

rollback.codeRollback: Revert cover URL policy, CSP and Author Studio selector changes.
rollback.dataRollbackOrForwardRepair: No migration; legacy values are not bulk rewritten.

collisionReview.sharedSurfaceOwners: Media owns policy; platform kernel integrates server guards; experience shell owns UI; platform quality owns tests.

status: Proposed; exact-head CI and review required.
